summary: Iteration 78: Stripe Payment System and Premium Access Control Testing. Backend: All 20 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: All critical flows verified - Payment page, AccessGate blocking, Stripe checkout redirect working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test users: expirado@teste.com (60 days old, expired status), teste.dono@teste.com (recent, in test period)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe payment system fully functional. All premium access restrictions working correctly. Backend tests cover: authentication, meu-plano endpoint for admin/valid/expired users, checkout session creation, access restrictions for raio-x/perfil/feed/strava/stories, public ranking access. Frontend tests cover: payment page display, AccessGate blocking on raio-x/feed/perfil, Stripe checkout redirect, cancelado page.
